name: TonWalletTransfer

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the transaction; may be empty if the transfer hasn't been sent yet

fields.name: peer_address
fields.description: Address of the transfer peer in the TON blockchain

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The amount of transferred cryptocurrency, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number; negative for outgoing transfers

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Comment added to the transfer; omitted if the comment is encrypted

description: Describes a service message about a transfer with a TON wallet.
